pull_requests.title: Add retry to invoice webhook sender
pull_requests.author: nora.dev
pull_requests.description: Webhook deliveries fail when the customer endpoint is slow. This adds 3 retries with a fixed 1s delay.

comments.author: sam.ops
comments.body: Should we use exponential backoff instead of a fixed delay?

files.patch:
--- a/billing/webhooks.py
+++ b/billing/webhooks.py
@@ -10,4 +10,9 @@ def send_invoice_webhook(url, payload):
-    return requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=5)
+    for attempt in range(3):
+        try:
+            return requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=5)
+        except requests.Timeout:
+            time.sleep(1)
+    raise WebhookError(url)

pull_requests.title: Fix rounding in VAT calculation
pull_requests.author: leo.fin
pull_requests.description: VAT totals were off by one cent on some invoices. Use Decimal and round half up.

files.patch:
--- a/billing/tax.py
+++ b/billing/tax.py
@@ -3,3 +3,4 @@
+from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
 def vat(amount, rate):
-    return round(amount * rate, 2)
+    return (Decimal(str(amount)) * Decimal(str(rate))).quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
